item.title: Version 1.0.28
item.description:
fix: app icon now has proper macOS squircle shape

Kyle and Rylan's installations rendered the icon as a hard-edged
black square because the source PNG was a fully-square black image
with no transparent corners.  macOS does not auto-mask Mac app icons
(only iOS does), so the raw artwork showed through.

The icon is now masked to the standard macOS rounded-corner shape
(~22.5% radius) with transparent corners.  Will look like every
other Mac app in the Dock, Launchpad, and Finder.
